summary: Completed focused frontend-only regression for Fortune Woods integration on public preview URL. Verified route, SEO/canonical, JSON-LD (6 offers), tariffs, inclusions, activities, galleries, homepage hero swap, Dandeli listings/nav menus, WhatsApp context, packages card behavior, contact form resort-switching, and shared Nature Mist/Land's End regressions across desktop/mobile viewports.
critical_code_review_comments: No release-blocking frontend code issues found in this focused Fortune Woods regression scope.

Note from verification: desktop sticky CTA intentionally auto-hides when footer intersects; if tested after scrolling to footer, sticky WhatsApp click will not fire by design (pointer-events disabled).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified PASS in runtime: /dandeli/fortune-woods title/meta/canonical, hero photo-5 + gallery photo-4/3/2/1 ordering and load, 6 exact tariffs with Per Person Per Night and river-view 4-sharing extra mattress note, 4 exact meals, 12 exact activities, no Nature Mist timing/sightseeing leakage on Fortune page, FAQ expand behavior, homepage hero uses /images/fortune-woods/photo-4.jpeg, homepage and /dandeli show exactly Nature Mist + Fortune Woods for Dandeli, desktop/mobile Dandeli dropdown contains only overview + Nature Mist + Fortune Woods, packages page Fortune card routes correctly and does not render check-in/out rows for Fortune, footer Fortune link works, WhatsApp URLs captured only as https://wa.me/917019540319 and Fortune-context text across hero/package/final/header/footer/sticky (sticky works when visible), Contact form Fortune selection has no undefined and no Nature Mist assumption, Land's End room/meal inputs still present and message includes selected room/meal, no horizontal overflow at 320/390/768/1440/1920, no option-nesting console regression observed.
rca of the issue: No functional defect found in requested scope. One intermediate test false-negative was caused by clicking sticky CTA after scrolling into footer where sticky auto-hide behavior is intentional.
